My dear [Mrs Mercier](/person/990)
Here is that charming little story at last.
One thing might I ask? Could not poor Maria’s one note of admiration be changed from Lor! I have rather the feeling that it is an abridgement of a more sacred word.[^1]
Did you mean Marian to blunder about feeding cows and milking chickens - ? Also did you send me a capital paper about fashion?

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: ‘Hints on Reading’ MP (April 1871), 418, recommends ‘Mr. Warne’s last Victoria Packet, where . . . Mrs.Filby’s Maria rises far above the general order of such little books’. However, since this letter evidently encloses a proof for correction, it presumably dates from the previous year. Several series of [‘Warne’s Victoria Toy Books: A Packet of Twelve Nursery Stories’](/book/211)were published. Since they appeared under CMY\'s editorship and several were anonymous, they are sometimes incorrectly catalogued as her work.
